basic_info.description: Exceptional Investment Opportunity!  Nestled in the heart of San Francisco's coveted Nob Hill neighborhood, this historic residential income apartment building offers a rare blend of classic elegance and modern functionality. Constructed in 1929, this timeless beauty spans approximately 9,000 square feet and is expertly configured into 13 distinct units across four levels, comprising of 11 studios and 2 two-bedroom units; 6 car enclosed parking; coin-operated laundry in garage. This building provides a versatile mix of living spaces that cater to a variety of tenant needs.    The architectural charm of the era is evident throughout, from the intricate detailing to the high ceilings, all while offering the conveniences of modern living. The property's prime location in Nob Hill, renowned for its historic landmarks, upscale dining, and proximity to downtown, enhances its appeal as a desirable residence for discerning tenants.    Whether you're a seasoned investor or looking to expand your portfolio, this building presents a unique opportunity to acquire a piece of San Francisco's architectural history, with the added benefit of strong rental income potential in one of the city's most prestigious neighborhoods.
